correctness.rationale: Reconstructed equations x'= -x from two y increments and z=y+x/2, giving z²+x²/4=1-1/beta and alpha cos x=beta z x². For 1<beta<=2 the bound x<sqrt2<pi/2 yields z>0 and bijective positive roots of Q_beta(x)=beta x² sqrt(R²-x²/4)/cosx with prime-two orbits. For beta<=1 no nonzero solution. Strict log concavity is reduced to a polynomial P(v) on [0,2] with all nine positive degree-eight Bernstein coefficients. Independently checked the exact polynomial identity and all nine rational Bernstein coefficients using SymPy. Q vanishes at both endpoints and has unique nondegenerate max; its root count is 0,1,2 across alpha*, and Taylor expansion gives square-root fold. Scaling x=2R s shows alpha*~8/(3sqrt3)(beta-1)^(3/2). Monotonicity alpha* follows pointwise Q_beta increasing in beta.
residual_risks: Fold is a fold in orbit solution roots, not necessarily a dynamical saddle-node with specified multipliers. beta>2 deliberately excluded.
